senses.gloss: injury, deterioration; blemish, discredit. Tanḥ. Vayishl. 5 פ׳ הוא לאשה it is discreditable to a woman (to be showy). Y. B. Kam. VIII, end, 6ᶜ; Bab.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 93a:11">B. Kam. 93ᵃ</cite> <he>משום פְּגַם משפחה</he> because it is a discredit to the entire family.

<cite ref="Gittin 59b:17">Gitt. 59ᵇ</cite> <he>משום פְּגָמוֹ של ראשון</he> because it might cast a reflection on his predecessor (making it appear as if he were not a legitimate priest); <he>משום פ׳ שניהם</he> because it reflects on both of them.
<cite ref="Sotah 41a:10">Sot. 41ᵃ</cite> <he>משום פגמו של ראשון</he> because it discredits the scroll first used (as if it had been found unfit for reading in it).
<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 92:1">Sifré Num. 92</cite> <he>דברי פ׳</he> criticising words, opp. <he>דברי שבח</he>.
Yalk. Ps. 846 ע״א קרויה לשם פְּגָמָהּ וכ׳ a heathen deity is named with an opprobrious epithet, as ḥerem, shekets &c., opp. לשם שבח; a. fr.—נותן טעם לפ׳, v. טַעַם.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 7:8:1">Cant. R. to VII, 8</cite> (in Chald. dict.) <he>אנן בעינן נתן ביה פ׳ וכ׳</he> we desire to discredit him (the idol), by being there and not bowing to him &c.—

senses.gloss: indemnity for deterioration in value or social standing, to be paid to a seduced or outraged girl.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 3:4">Keth. III, 4</cite> <he>המפתה נותן בושת ופ׳ וקנס</he> the seducer must pay an indemnity for exposure to shame and for loss of value, and a fine besides.
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 3:7">Ib. 7</cite> <he>פ׳ רואין אותה וכ׳</he> as to indemnity for loss of value, we estimate her as if she were a handmaid to be sold &c.

senses.gloss: (v. פְּגִימָה) the decrease of the moon; trnsf. decline.
units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 15:1">Pesik. R. s. 15</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 89:38">Ps. LXXXIX, 38</cite>) <he>כהדין סיהרא … אתם מונין לפְגָמוֹ</he> like the moon: if you do good, you shall count by its fulness (by referring to your political ascendancy); if not, you shall count by its decrease (by the symptoms of decline); Pesik. Haḥod., p. 53ᵃ <he>לפְגָמָהּ</he>; v. <cite ref="Q00077">next w.</cite>
